public.description: May enter a public serving bundle only when explicit publication permissions for the material type are allow.

project-internal.description: Project-only material; not public serving input.

restricted-license.description: License-restricted source material. Derived outputs require their own explicit publication permission before any public promotion.

secret.description: Secrets/credentials or equivalently protected material; never public.

rule: If the right to publish cannot be demonstrated, raw text is not published.
